command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE3','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','SZ_AR'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u4='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u5='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u4 -Method Get).output -split \"`r?`n\"); `$b=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u5 -Method Get).output -split \"`r?`n\"); Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$a -DifferenceObject `$b | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject) }}"
